Name: Senegal Parrot Kids
Author: DaisyNiko
Description:
this is just a recolour of Ankokou's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/309]Bird Replacements for Babies and Toddlers[/url]﻿ — from lovebirds to senegal parrots because i wanted my own irl child in the game. also replaces the crib with a cage and edits all the strings and marriage dialogue to be about feathered dinosaur children instead of human ones

[b]note: [/b]you might also want to download clockworkhound's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3540]ChildBedConfig[/url] to remove the kids' beds (not the crib, though) from your farmhouse/cabins


[b][size=3][color=#ff0000]fe[/color][color=#ff7700]a[/color][color=#ffff00]tu[/color][color=#00ff00]r[/color][color=#00ffff]e[/color][color=#ff00ff]s[/color][/size]

[/b]- replaces kids with birds
- replaces crib with cage (sprite from original mod)
- edits of all strings and marriage dialogue to match


[b][size=3][color=#ff0000]in[/color][color=#ff7700]st[/color][color=#ffff00]al[/color][color=#00ff00]la[/color][color=#00ffff]ti[/color][color=#ff00ff]on[/color][/size][/b]

1. install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
2. download this mod and open the .zip folder
3. extract "[CP] Senegal Parrot Kids" to [code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]
4. run the game using SMAPI
